Melotte_22.adql: SELECT TOP 60000 source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, parallax, parallax_over_error, phot_g_mean_mag AS G, bp_rp, ruwe FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',56.576956,24.146404,1.825266)) AND parallax_over_error >= 5.0 AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 18.0 AND pmra IS NOT NULL
